title: Computerized adaptive testing
text: Selection rules: maximum Fisher information ("MFI"), posterior-weighted information ("MPWI"), Kullback-Leibler ("KL"), minimum expected posterior variance ("MEPV") "random". Exposure control: randomesque, Sympson-Hetter (cat_sympson_hetter() calibrates parameters) -stratification (strata =). Stopping rules: test length, SE target classification cut scores (cut =).
code: design <- cat_design(bank, select = "MFI", estimator = "EAP",                      min_items = 5, max_items = 30, se_target = 0.30,                      exposure = "randomesque", randomesque_k = 5,                      content_target = c(Algebra = 0.4, Geometry = 0.3, Number = 0.3)) design #> <cat_design> 300-item bank #>   selection: MFI | estimator: EAP (prior N(0.00, 1.00^2)) #>   exposure control: randomesque (k = 5) #>   content balancing: Algebra 40%, Geometry 30%, Number 30%  #>   stopping: 5-30 items; SE <= 0.300

title: Computerized adaptive testing
text: cat_start(), cat_next() cat_answer() give item--item loop behind web form ‘shiny’ app.
code: s <- cat_start(design) true_theta <- 0.8 while (!cat_done(s)) {   item <- cat_next(s)   p <- 1 / (1 + exp(-bank$items[[item]]$a * (true_theta + bank$items[[item]]$d / bank$items[[item]]$a)))   s <- cat_answer(s, item, rbinom(1, 1, p)) } s #> <cat_session> 17 item(s) administered | theta = 0.763, SE = 0.299 | finished: se_target #>  step item response theta    se #>     8 I069        0 0.332 0.415 #>     9 I297        1 0.414 0.390 #>    10 I040        1 0.516 0.375 #>    11 I011        1 0.602 0.365 #>    12 I288        1 0.689 0.354 #>    13 I271        0 0.599 0.336 #>    14 I070        1 0.682 0.329 #>    15 I130        1 0.780 0.323 #>    16 I152        0 0.711 0.307 #>    17 I105        1 0.763 0.299 plot(s)

title: IRTistic 0.1.0
text: First release. Models: Rasch, 2PL, 3PL, 4PL, GRM, PCM, GPCM, RSM; mixed item types; confirmatory multidimensional models; many-facet Rasch models. Scoring: EAP, MAP, ML, WLE; Lord-Wingersky summed-score tables. Diagnostics: infit/outfit, S-X², reliability separation, Q3, residual PCA, classification accuracy consistency. DIF: Mantel-Haenszel, logistic regression, Lord’s Wald test anchor purification, Raju’s areas, SIDS/UIDS. Linking equating: mean-mean, mean-sigma, Haebara, Stocking-Lord; true-score equating. Adaptive testing: design, live sessions, Monte Carlo post-hoc simulation, exposure control, content balancing, classification stopping. Graphics, publication tables (irt_table()) one-call HTML reports (irt_report()).
